Can happen accidentally - Applies even if you paraphrase/translate

notions.why: liste explicite + consigne « Pay strict attention »

src.quote: Translation plagiarism: Translating a text from another language without citing the source.
Self-plagiarism: Recycling previous work that you have already submitted or published.

label.fr: Éviter le plagiat (traçabilité des sources, citer systématiquement)

src.quote: Keep track of all sources: Articles, books, websites, videos, whitepapers, blog posts, etc.
Copy exact words, use quotation marks, cite source.
Put text into your own words, no quotation marks, cite source.
Rule: Quoting $> 30$ words $\rightarrow$ need to paraphrase!
Use paraphrasing and citations when you translate concepts from English into French.
